starScale.1: Levy and squires: untrained bodies pressed into the line.
starScale.4: Specialists, scouts, light riders, cell leaders.
starScale.8: Greater elites, true dragons, siege beasts.
starScale.10: Deities, gods, Kage, shoguns and kings.

notes.tribute: Tributes are your own deployed units sacrificed to summon the card. A null tribute cost means the unit cannot be summoned from the main deck at all: it arrives only through a ritual or fusion card in the side deck.
notes.copyLimit: A zero copy limit means the card may not sit in the main deck. Named unique units are always limited to one regardless of star.
notes.sideDeck: The side deck holds only ritual and fusion cards. They are never drawn; they are played from the side deck when their requirements are met on the field.
notes.primaryFaction: A deck is led by one faction: at least 40 of its 100 cards must belong to it. The rest may be sworn allies, so a Samurai host can field borrowed Knight guns without becoming a Knight deck. Raise this toward 60 once each faction has fifteen or more distinct cards.
notes.cardPool: Copy limits are generous at the low stars because a hundred-card deck is mostly line soldiers. As the card pool grows these limits should tighten.
